_comment: Example configuration for distance-to-wall inlet profile
_description: This config demonstrates the distance-to-wall inlet velocity profile for irregular aortic root geometries. Use this when the inlet is non-circular or when valve dynamics affect the flow pattern.

inlet._comment_profile: Distance-to-wall profile options: distance_wall, power_law, poiseuille_distance, hybrid_jet, blunted
inlet._comment_shape: Shape function: poiseuille (default), power_law, hybrid_jet, blunted_parabolic
inlet._comment_exponent: Power law exponent n for shape function. Higher = flatter core, steeper wall gradient
inlet._comment_core: Core fraction for hybrid/blunted profiles (0-1). Defines flat core region size.
inlet._comment_flow_rate: Enable flow rate correction to ensure Q matches CSV exactly
inlet._comment_orientation: Orientation: 'auto' (detect from geometry), 'in' (into domain), 'out' (out of domain)
